input.title: BUG: test assert methods failing on object dtype column with lists of different nesting
input.body:
When using `assert_series_equal` or `assert_frame_equal` with a Series/DataFrame with an object dtype column with lists of different nesting, I see a failure instead of the correct AssertionError.

First, example with unequal flat list (here different length, but could also be different numbers), this works as expected:

```python
>>> ser1 = pd.Series([1, [1, 2], "b"], dtype=object)
>>> ser2 = pd.Series([1, [1, 2, 3], "b"], dtype=object)
>>> pd.testing.assert_series_equal(ser1, ser2)
...
AssertionError: Series are different

Series values are different (33.33333 %)
[index]: [0, 1, 2]
[left]:  [1, [1, 2], b]
[right]: [1, [1, 2, 3], b]
At positional index 1, first diff: [1, 2] != [1, 2, 3]
```

But when comparing with a nested list, it fails:

```python
>>> ser2 = pd.Series([1, [[1, 2]], "b"], dtype=object)
>>> pd.testing.assert_series_equal(ser1, ser2)
---------------------------------------------------------------------------
TypeError                                 Traceback (most recent call last)
Cell In[8], line 1
----> 1 pd.testing.assert_series_equal(ser1, ser2)

    [... skipping hidden 2 frame]

File pandas/_libs/testing.pyx:66, in pandas._libs.testing.assert_almost_equal()

File pandas/_libs/testing.pyx:198, in pandas._libs.testing.assert_almost_equal()

File pandas/_libs/testing.pyx:190, in pandas._libs.testing.assert_almost_equal()

TypeError: unhashable type: 'list'
```
